Coletar Cabeçalho OC.body:
=<soapenv:Envelope
    xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"
    xmlns:ser="http://services.senior.com.br">

    <soapenv:Header/>

    <soapenv:Body>
        <ser:GetDBInfo>

            <user>__SENIOR_USER__</user>
            <password>__SENIOR_PASSWORD__</password>
            <encryption>0</encryption>

            <parameters>

                <pmSQL>SELECT CODEMP, CODFIL, NUMOCP, TNSPRO, TNSSER, DATEMI, CODFOR, VLRLIQ, VLRFIN, VLRORI, NUMAPR, SITAPR, SITOCP, USUGER, FILAPR, ROTNAP, USU_DATVECT, USU_NUMNFC, USU_NUMTIT, USU_CONFRO, USU_REEMB FROM E420OCP WHERE CODEMP=:CodEmp AND CODFIL=:CodFil AND NUMOCP=:NumOcp</pmSQL>

                <pmParams><?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><params><param><name>CodEmp</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codEmp}}</value></param><param><name>CodFil</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codFil}}</value></param><param><name>NumOcp</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.numOcp}}</value></param></params></pmParams>

            </parameters>

        </ser:GetDBInfo>
    </soapenv:Body>

</soapenv:Envelope>

Coletar Rateios OC.body:
=<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ser="http://services.senior.com.br"> <soapenv:Header/> <soapenv:Body> <ser:GetDBInfo> <user>__SENIOR_USER__</user> <password>__SENIOR_PASSWORD__</password> <encryption>0</encryption> <parameters> <pmSQL>
SELECT
    R.*,
    PF.DESCTA AS DESCTAFIN,
    CC.DESCCU AS DESCCU
FROM
    E420RAT R,
    E091PLF PF,
    E044CCU CC
WHERE R.CODEMP = :CodEmp
  AND R.CODFIL = :CodFil
  AND R.NUMOCP = :NumOcp
  AND PF.CODEMP = R.CODEMP
  AND PF.CTAFIN = R.CTAFIN
  AND CC.CODEMP = R.CODEMP
  AND CC.CODCCU = R.CODCCU
</pmSQL> <pmParams><?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><params><param><name>CodEmp</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codEmp}}</value></param><param><name>CodFil</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codFil}}</value></param><param><name>NumOcp</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.numOcp}}</value></param></params></pmParams> </parameters> </ser:GetDBInfo> </soapenv:Body> </soapenv:Envelope>

Coletar Cadastro Aprovadores.body:
=<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:ser="http://services.senior.com.br">
  <soapenv:Header/>
  <soapenv:Body>
    <ser:GetDBInfo>

      <user>__SENIOR_USER__</user>
      <password>__SENIOR_PASSWORD__</password>
      <encryption>0</encryption>

      <parameters>

        <pmSQL>SELECT
    U.*,
    R.NOMCOM AS NOMCOMPLETO,
    R.DESUSU AS DESCRICAOUSUARIO
FROM
    E099USU U,
    R910USU R
WHERE U.CODEMP = :CodEmp
  AND U.CODUSU = :CodUsu
  AND R.CODENT = U.CODUSU</pmSQL>

        <pmParams><?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><params><param><name>CodEmp</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codEmp}}</value></param><param><name>CodUsu</name><type>Integer</type><value>{{$json.codUsu}}</value></param></params></pmParams>

      </parameters>

    </ser:GetDBInfo>
  </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
